## Hi, I'm Stephen.

I've spent **20+ years** in bioinformatics, genomics, and life-sciences data science. That sounds like a long time until you remember how much the field has changed in just the last five. The questions stay the same though: **how do we make sense of complex biomedical data, and how do we turn it into something that actually helps people?**

For five years I led Professional Services at **Biorelate**, a UK biomedical AI company. In practice that meant making sure the science connected to what clients actually needed: accelerating a drug-discovery pipeline, untangling a messy real-world data workflow, or helping a team understand what they'd got and what they could do with it. Since June 2026 I've worked as an independent consultant and adviser through my own company, **Carmen Provenance LTD**.

Before this I worked across **academia, the NHS, and pharma**, building and leading teams, shipping ML models, and trying to make large-scale data projects land well in the real world.

Somewhere along the way I appear to have become an **Agentic Engineer**. Not by design, more by osmosis and a stubborn refusal to fall behind the LLM Joneses. Right now I'm particularly interested in where **knowledge graphs, RAG, and multi-omics data** are heading, and what that means for personalised medicine.

::: {.callout-note appearance="minimal"}
**Always happy to connect** with people working at the intersection of data, biology, and drug discovery. → [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/in/sjnewhouse/) · [Email](mailto:stephen.j.newhouse@gmail.com)

### Recent outcomes

- Sole engineer on a production **agent SDK and MCP server** over a biomedical knowledge graph (memory, tool-use, evaluation, knowledge-graph reasoning), integrated by a top-10 global pharma into one of their internal agentic AI platforms.
- Sole architect of a **multi-agent target safety assessment system**: knowledge graph + LLM evidence retrieval, programmatic citation, citation-traced reports in hours rather than weeks.
- Built and ran a **Professional Services and consulting function** from zero.

### What I'm working on

- **Biomedical AI**. Knowledge graphs, NLP, target, drug, and biomarker discovery, indication expansion.
- **Agentic AI**. Memory, tool-use, evaluation. See [`aa-ma-forge`](https://github.com/snewhouse/aa-ma-forge).
- **Genomics tooling**. Curating [`awesome-genetics-software`](https://github.com/snewhouse/awesome-genetics-software).
- **Writing & sharing**. See the [blog](posts.qmd) and [archived talks](archive.qmd).
